brief_data.deck: Also, the small-EV company spun out of Rivian, closed a $200M Series C led by Greenoaks on 31 March 2026 with DoorDash as strategic investor, taking funding to $305M at a $1B valuation. Its president built Specialized's product line, and Specialized just took the bike lane at Audi.

risks.label: PRE-REVENUE HARDWARE
risks.detail: The TM-B has not yet shipped at scale; a consumer hardware company can slip its dates and cut marketing first.
risks.counter: Structure year one as product-led (fleet in kind, modest fee) with cash stepping up as deliveries land.

risks.label: OEM SENSITIVITY
risks.detail: Rivian holds a minority stake and chairs the board; Ford supplies the power unit from 2026.
risks.counter: Position Also as the independent company it is; test the Ford and Rivian sensitivities on the first call.

extended.ask: A 25-minute call with Chris Yu before the Monaco GP to size a product-led Official Mobility Partner entry at Racing Bulls for 2027, agree the fleet plan, and test the Ford and Rivian sensitivities with the team.

value.text: A TM-B fleet for the team's daily mobility at all 24 rounds: track rides for drivers and engineers, paddock commutes for mechanics and hospitality staff, recovery rides for the drivers' performance programme. The removable 240W battery doubles as a power bank for trackside crews. As the cargo quad enters production it takes over short-haul paddock logistics.
value.label: Operational workstream (Mode A)

value.text: A design-led consumer brand with a Rivian pedigree brings a launch-year marketing budget, a product the drivers can be filmed on, and a hospitality guest list of retail, mobility and venture contacts at Monaco and Las Vegas.
value.label: Commercial lift for the team

value.text: A team-liveried TM-B edition, driver and mechanic content on the bikes, and a paddock-to-city story that fits Also's mission of replacing short car trips. The DoorDash autonomy programme gives a second chapter for 2028 when the delivery vehicles are on the road.
value.label: Content and ecosystem

value.text: Official Mobility Partner designation, rear-wing or halo placement, kit presence, hospitality at Monaco and Las Vegas, and driver access for Also's launch content.
value.label: What the team gives back

why_now.text: On 31 March 2026 Also announced its $200M Series C closed, led by Greenoaks with DoorDash joining as strategic investor alongside Prysm Capital, together with a multi-year commercial agreement to develop autonomous last-mile delivery vehicles for DoorDash and a board-observer seat for DoorDash co-founder Stanley Tang. TechCrunch puts total funding at $305M and the valuation at $1B. Greenoaks' investment was first reported by Bloomberg in July 2025; the desk row dated the round to May, which is wrong.
why_now.label: Trigger

why_now.text: On 21 May 2026, the day before this brief, Specialized announced a multi-year partnership with Audi Revolut F1 Team as official bicycle and e-bike supplier for 2026 and 2027, providing the fleet the team uses for daily mobility, training and recovery. That is the first e-bike partnership on the F1 grid and the template for this one.
why_now.label: The category clock started at Audi

why_now.text: The $4,500 TM-B Launch Edition, revealed in October 2025, begins US deliveries this spring, with Europe to follow; about 350 people now work across Palo Alto, Seattle and a new commercial team in Ghent. A company with its first product and a fresh raise decides its launch marketing now.
why_now.label: First product, first budget

why_now.text: Monaco GP (5-7 June) and the British GP (3-5 July) fall inside the window; the US GP in Austin and the Las Vegas GP in the autumn are the home-market stages a US launch would be timed to. A deal agreed before Silverstone can be announced in the US and activated in full for 2027.
why_now.label: Calendar window

why_team.text: Racing Bulls carries Visa and Cash App, Randstad, Siemens, Hugo, Tudor, Dynatrace, Confluent, Yugo, Student.com, Airtasker, Mobil 1 and Nouryon, with Ford supplying the power unit from 2026. No bicycle, e-bike or mobility partner is on the roster: Official Mobility Partner is a clean category at a team-partner price.
why_team.label: The open lane

why_team.text: Visa, Cash App, Yugo, Student.com and Airtasker are consumer brands aimed at a younger audience; a $4,500 design-led e-bike from a Rivian spin-out sells to the same people. The team's partner list is the closest thing on the grid to Also's customer profile.
why_team.label: The audience

why_team.text: Track rides, paddock commutes and recovery sessions are daily work for a race team; the Specialized deal at Audi shows a team taking a bike fleet as an operational supply, not a logo. Also's removable batteries add a trackside power-bank role no other bike brand offers.
why_team.label: A team that will use the product

why_team.text: Ford's role at Racing Bulls is a power-unit supply through Red Bull Powertrains, not a brand exclusivity; Rivian holds a minority stake in Also and RJ Scaringe chairs its board. The brief treats this as a sensitivity to test on the first call, not a bar, and rules out the works and OEM-owned teams where it would be.
why_team.label: The OEM question, answered honestly

ruled_out.reason: Specialized is the team's official bicycle and e-bike partner for 2026 and 2027; a direct rival.
Zoox, Amazon's autonomous-vehicle company, sits on the roster; Also's DoorDash autonomy programme would clash.
Mobilize Financial Services, Renault's mobility brand, holds the mobility lane.
General Motors is the parent; a Rivian-born brand will not sit on GM's car.
Toyota Gazoo Racing technical partnership; OEM sensitivity for a Rivian spin-out.

ruled_out.team: Mercedes-AMG Petronas · Scuderia Ferrari HP · McLaren Mastercard · Aston Martin Aramco
ruled_out.reason: Works or car-maker-branded teams: OEM sensitivity, and partner prices beyond a first-product company.
Open on category, but a 30-plus partner roster at senior-team prices; the junior team is the right first step.

brief_data.bottom_line: A $200M Series C with DoorDash aboard, a first product shipping this spring, and a president who built the product line of the brand that just took the e-bike lane at Audi give Also the budget, the motive and the template. Racing Bulls has the audience and the open slot, and Monaco sits inside the window.

brief_data.the_case_p1: Also spun out of Rivian in March 2025 with $105M from Rivian and Eclipse after three years inside the carmaker as Project Inder. Bloomberg reported Greenoaks' $200M at a $1B valuation in July 2025; the Series C was announced closed on 31 March 2026 with DoorDash joining alongside Prysm Capital, a multi-year agreement to build autonomous last-mile delivery vehicles, and DoorDash co-founder Stanley Tang as board observer. Total funding is $305M. The first product, the $4,500 TM-B e-bike revealed in October 2025, starts US deliveries this spring; about 350 staff work in Palo Alto, Seattle and Ghent.
brief_data.the_case_p2: The category precedent landed this week: Specialized became Audi Revolut F1 Team's official bicycle and e-bike partner for 2026 and 2027, supplying the fleet the team rides for daily mobility, training and recovery. Chris Yu spent more than ten years at Specialized as chief product and technology officer before co-founding Also. The template exists, the man who built the incumbent's product now runs the challenger, and the challenger has a fresh $200M to spend.

brief_data.value_content: MODE A - operational. The Specialized template, run by the team that built it: a TM-B fleet for track rides, paddock commutes and driver recovery sessions at every round, the removable battery doubling as a 240W power bank for trackside crews, and the cargo quad for paddock logistics once in production. In return: Official Mobility Partner designation, livery and kit presence, Monaco and Las Vegas hospitality, and the drivers on the bikes on camera.
brief_data.why_team_para: Racing Bulls carries Visa and Cash App at the front, with Yugo, Student.com, Airtasker and Hugo behind them: a roster built for a younger consumer audience, the buyer of a $4,500 design-led e-bike. No bicycle, e-bike or mobility partner sits on the team. Ford supplies the power unit from 2026, a supply agreement rather than a brand exclusivity, so a Rivian-born partner is a conversation, not a bar. It is the grid's natural first-timer stage: a team-partner price and 24 rounds of paddock use.
brief_data.deal_arch_para: Entry as Official Mobility Partner. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>THREE YEARS</font>, 2027-2029, spanning the TM-B ramp, the DoorDash delivery programme and a probable further raise. Estimated $1-2M a year plus product, with the fleet supplied in kind. Scope: rear-wing or halo placement, a team-liveried TM-B edition, Monaco and Las Vegas hospitality, driver content on the bikes.
brief_data.why_team_label: WHY VISA CASH APP RACING BULLS
brief_data.why_now_callout: <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9'>WHY NOW</font>  Specialized's Audi deal was announced on 21 May, the day before this brief, and makes e-bikes a live F1 category. Also's US deliveries begin this spring on a fresh $200M. Monaco GP (7 June) and the British GP (5 July) fall inside the window; the US GP and Las Vegas follow in the autumn.
brief_data.decision_maker_bio: Yu co-founded Also with RJ Scaringe after more than a decade at Specialized as chief product and technology officer and a spell as Rivian's VP of future programmes; he runs the company. Path: Ben Steele, Chief Commercial Officer (ex-REI); Scaringe chairs the board. No CEO or CMO title is listed.
brief_data.opening_angle_quote: “Chris, Specialized just took the bike lane at Audi with the product line you built. The challenger belongs on a car too, and Racing Bulls has the audience and the open slot. 25 minutes before Monaco to see the fleet plan?”
